# Notices and errors

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-notice-docs.mjs from src/notices.ts and src/errors.ts; do not edit. -->

## Notices

A notice is something a command did on your behalf that the input did not say: a value changed, a result narrowed, a request that had nothing to act on. It never fails a command. Commands that can produce one add a `notices` array to their JSON (and nothing when there is nothing to say); match on `code`, not on the message.

```json
{ "code": "N_SCALE_SNAP", "severity": "warn", "message": "...", "pointer": "/layers/0/source/pitch", "requested": 466, "applied": "A#4", "hint": "..." }
```

`severity` is `warn` when the caller may be acting on a false belief and `info` when the output is merely narrower than it looks. `pointer`, `requested` and `applied` are present when they apply.

| Code | Severity | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `N_SCALE_SNAP` | warn | A pitched layer renders at a different pitch than written, because the project scale snaps pitches to its notes. | write a pitch that is in the scale, change the scale in .agent-beeps/project.json, or set scale.snap to false to render pitches as written |
| `N_VARIANTS_IDENTICAL` | warn | The patch declares several variants, but nothing in its variation block changes the sound, so every variant renders the same samples. | add variation.pitchCents (needs a pitched layer) or variation.gainDb, or author sibling patches that differ |
| `N_NO_VARIANTS` | info | Variants were requested for a patch that declares no variants, so one render was made. | declare variation.variants in the patch (see the beeps-compose skill) before asking for variants |

## Errors

A failure is an error on stderr, `{ "error": { "code", "category", "retryable", "message", ... } }`, with exit code 1 (2 for a usage error caught while parsing options). `pointer` names the field at fault, `hint` says what to do, and `received` echoes the rejected value (cut to 80 characters). `category` says who has to act: change your input, repair the environment, accept the outcome, retry, or report a bug.

| Code | Category | Retryable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `E_USAGE` | input | no |
| `E_SCHEMA` | input | no |
| `E_NOT_FOUND` | input | no |
| `E_CONFLICT` | input | no |
| `E_PROJECT` | input | no |
| `E_PREDICTION_REQUIRED` | input | no |
| `E_BUDGET` | input | no |
| `E_BROWSER_MISSING` | environment | no |
| `E_RUNTIME_MISSING` | environment | no |
| `E_TOOLCHAIN` | environment | no |
| `E_RENDER` | outcome | no |
| `E_VERIFY` | outcome | no |
| `E_NONDETERMINISTIC` | outcome | no |
| `E_LOCK` | transient | yes |
| `E_SERVER` | transient | yes |
| `E_STORE` | transient | yes |
| `E_INTERNAL` | bug | no |
